---
title: "First New Zealand radar workshop and report to the NZ Space Agency"
date: 2024-01-01   # TODO: exact date (the CVs give only the year)
description: "Rodrigo led the first New Zealand Radar Workshop, which led the New Zealand Space Agency to commission a report on radar remote sensing in New Zealand."
categories: [event, report]
---

Rodrigo led the organisation of the first New Zealand Radar Workshop, a one-day
meeting of practitioners, industry and academia on the future of radar remote sensing
in New Zealand. As a result, the New Zealand Space Agency asked the organising
committee for a report, which is listed on the [Reports](../reports.qmd) page.
